name: Goblin Hexer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes two Hex Stick attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Hex Stick
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The goblin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): At will: Minor Illusion. 1/Day Each: Blindness/Deafness, Faerie Fire, Grease.

reactions.name: Jinx
reactions.description: When a creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll, the goblin can force that creature to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attack misses instead.

description: Goblin hexers are flashy, theatrical spellcasters who dress in exaggerated mimicry of archmages, disrupting foes with illusions and curses while the warband closes in.
